description: Screening gas-cycle thermochemistry. Evaluated reference data plus one older experimental entropy; not a consistent new thermochemical evaluation.
evaluation_choices: Organic Cp is linearly interpolated between listed points and integrated analytically. No extrapolation is allowed.
Water and H2 use NIST Shomate H(T)-H(298.15) and S(T) directly at 773 K within their stated ranges. Water Cp is not extrapolated below 500 K.
Benzene uses Prosen Hf298 rather than the close Roux evaluation; ethylbenzene uses Prosen Hf298 and Miller S298, excluding old discrepant Hf entries.
Ethanol and methanol use Gurvich Hf298/S298 as served by CCCBDB, combined with WebBook recommended Cp tables. This mixing of evaluations adds unquantified uncertainty.

Toluene uses the older experimental entropy reported by Taylor et al. 1946 Table 8, not its calculated entropy. The original p102 image was inspected. Conversion from 298.16 K/1 atm to 298.15 K/1 bar uses the listed near-room-temperature Cp and ideal-gas pressure correction.

Unlabelled standard-pressure conventions for other selected entropy values are treated as 1 bar for this screening calculation. Residual 1 atm/1 bar ambiguity is not resolved and limits high-precision interpretation.
Acetophenone Cp(T) is absent. Only its required missing Cp correction is computed; no 773 K K or absolute Gibbs energy is assigned.

Reported input uncertainties do not have a common verified confidence convention. Entropy/Cp covariances and several errors are missing. RSS enthalpy errors are diagnostic only; the +/-5 kJ/mol scenario is sensitivity, not a confidence interval.

sources.selection: Hf: Prosen/Gilmont/Rossini 1945 with Prosen/Johnson/Rossini 1946 formation value; S: Miller 1978; Cp: TRC 1997 recommended table.
